goal: Restore the proof-carrying representation/interface layer that was progressively dropped while JANUS optimized trajectory selection, before any new factoring performance claim.

contract: All exact arithmetic facts are typed semantic nodes, not scalar labels.
Canonical semantic payloads are hash-consed; provenance is stored as separate exact edges and may have multiple sources.
Hash identity never makes payload bytes or lookup/canonicalization work free.
Repeated modular powers, gcd chains, residue identities, order multiples, exact orders, difference-of-squares relations, projections and factors are reusable first-class nodes.
A cached result without a replayable context projection cannot silently change search geometry.

CERTIFICATE_PORTFOLIO.discovery_rule: Generate/freeze the complete candidate-language manifest before probing; probe every candidate under explicit work/representation/certificate caps; select only among exact-certified outcomes.

CONTEXT_PROJECTION.contract: Every nonterminal certificate must either produce a verifier-replayable exact restriction/equivalence/refinement on future state or return NO_TRACTABLE_PROJECTION.
CONTEXT_PROJECTION.forbidden_shortcut: Changing an ORBIT base, ranking an operator, or emitting a scalar feature is not a projection unless an exact future-state reduction is certified.
CONTEXT_PROJECTION.safe_merge_rule: States may merge only under an exact portfolio-relative future-message equivalence certificate.
CONTEXT_PROJECTION.safe_split_rule: A partition refinement requires an explicit replayable separating continuation/certificate.

OFFSET_AND_POSITION_AWARE_MESSAGES.contract: Representation shape alone is insufficient. Full operands, offsets/coset/position information and consistency signatures required by the certificate language remain bound to the node/message.

ARITHMETIC_INTERFACE_PROFILE.rule: Measure before/after each operator and projection. Do not collapse to a claimed complexity width until an exact recurrence theorem justifies that scalarization.
ARITHMETIC_INTERFACE_PROFILE.desired_future_theorem: If a formally defined live arithmetic cut width k controls all future messages, seek a proof of FPT/poly behavior analogous to prior exact interface/trellis results; no such theorem is claimed here.

CAPABILITY_DIGEST.lifecycle_rule: An OPEN/portfolio-exhausted result remains exact for its recorded capability. A stronger successor capability may mark it CAPABILITY_STALE_FOR_SUCCESSOR but may never erase or rewrite the historical verdict.

PIPPI_PAID_UTILITY.contract: After an episode, record exact terminal, total charged work, representation/canonicalization/lookup cost, reuse, projection success and interface-profile delta. Current-episode outcomes cannot increase current-episode selecting authority.

TOPA_SPIDER_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.contract: TOPA+Spider may connect cycles, mechanisms, barriers and current results. Association edges can prioritize audits and candidate languages but cannot certify arithmetic facts or prune frozen exact scope.
TOPA_SPIDER_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.exact_edge_requirement: Any edge used by the kernel must point to a replayable exact certificate.

certificate_projection_contracts_v1.DIRECT_GCD_FACTOR: terminal factor iff 1<g<N and g divides N exactly
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.EUCLIDEAN_GCD_CHAIN: replayable gcd equality chain; terminal only for a nontrivial divisor
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.DIFFERENCE_OF_SQUARES: store full x,y and identity x^2-y^2; project to nontrivial gcd factors when exact, otherwise retain relation without invented restriction
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.MODULAR_POWER_EQUALITY: store base, exponent, residue and modulus; reusable by exact equality only
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.RESIDUE_COLLISION_ORDER_MULTIPLE: a^i=a^j mod N projects to the exact divisibility constraint ord_N(a) | |i-j|; no claim that candidate is minimal order
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.EXACT_MULTIPLICATIVE_ORDER: minimality must be independently certified; may enable exact Shor postprocess
certificate_projection_contracts_v1.NEAR_SQUARE_EXACT_RELATION: store full x,y,epsilon and (x-y)(x+y)=N+epsilon. epsilon alone has no authority. If no exact restriction on future N-state is derived, return NO_TRACTABLE_PROJECTION.

accounting.total_compute: sum all modular multiplications, integer multiplications, gcd operations, trial/division work, canonicalization, hashing proportional to bytes processed, lookup comparisons, projection verification and certificate verification
accounting.memory: count unique semantic payload bytes once plus every reference/index/provenance edge and working-table entry
accounting.latency: reported separately and never substituted for total compute
accounting.reuse_credit: allowed only for a content-addressed semantic node already constructed and verified in the charged ledger

forbidden_regressions: independent dual-core execution presented as synergy
best scalar summary substituted for full exact interface
unpaid candidate discovery or variable/layout/language oracle
post-outcome candidate generation within the same frozen episode
OPEN promoted to hardness or negative theorem evidence
same-episode Pippi learning changes current selecting authority
more ORBIT budget presented as a new complexity mechanism
comparison only against linear order scan after BSGS/rho baselines are available
